parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the image formed by a converging lens. Refer to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Switch on the lamp. • Place the lens at a distance u = 20.0 cm from the illuminated object (the triangular hole in the card). • Adjust the position of the screen until a sharp image of the illuminated object is formed on the screen. Measure, to the nearest 0.1 cm, the image distance v from the centre of the lens to the screen. Record the image distance v in the top row of Table 3.1. Table 3.1 object distance u / cm image distance v / cm 20.0 25.0 35.0 45.0 55.0 60.0 [1]
